title: The Twin Fates Descend
next_chapter_hook: The Demonic Path commander released a mysterious power that resonated with Chen Ji's bloodline, causing the Tianji Record to undergo a bizarre reaction—its ancient runes on the fragment began burning on their own.

text.content:
At the Back Mountain Cliff of Tianqing Sect.

Chen Ji stood at the cliff's edge, beneath his feet was an abyss of countless zhang, above his head were铅-like clouds pressing down. In his hand, he gripped the fragmented Tianji Record, its yellowed pages trembling slightly in the wind.

Within three days, he must make a choice—save Ye Qing who had fallen into the Demonic Path, preserve his own cultivation, or venture into the Forbidden Grounds to find his sister Chen Nian. Three paths, three fates, yet he could only choose one.

"Tianji Record, activate." He murmured softly, his spiritual sense at his brow center beginning to coalesce. Foreseeing the next three hours—this was his greatest trump card.

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's voice of the remnant soul echoed in his mind, carrying a weight of solemnity: "Chen Ji, this choice concerns the grand trend of the Heavenly Dao. Are you truly going to use the Tianji Record? Every foresight consumes five points of Heavenly Fate... Your current Heavenly Fate is already less than thirty."

Chen Ji did not respond. His gaze pierced through the layers of mist, as if he had already glimpsed the outline of the future.

text.content:
At that moment—

The Tianji Record in his hand suddenly violently trembled, as if something was frantically撞击 the seal. The yellowed pages turned on their own, revealing the blank reverse side that had never appeared before.

"What's happening?" Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. This fragment had been with him for over a decade, never once had it reacted so violently.

Immediately afterward, a pressure that made his scalp tingle descended from the heavens above, like an ancient fierce beast opening its sleeping eyes.

The heavens cracked open.

Not ordinary lightning, not usual storms. That rift tore down straight from the nine heavens, its edges flowing with chaotic purple-gold hues, as if someone had cleaved the entire sky in two with a giant axe.

From the abyss beneath the cliff came continuous wails, the sound of heavenly laws being forcibly torn apart. Chen Ji felt his primordial spirit trembling—this was a suppression from a higher dimension.

From that rift, two figures slowly emerged.

No—that was clearly one figure, yet possessing two faces. One was a beauty whose countenance could topple nations, with a vertical eye between her brows; the other was a handsome to the point of妖异的 male face, with pupils as black as the abyss.

The two faces shared one body, black and white long hair interweaving and dancing in the void.

This was the legendary—the Twin Fates.

dialogue.content:
"I have waited for you for a long time."

The lips of that body slightly parted, yet what emerged was a诡异 overlapping of male and female voices. The female voice was melodious and moving, the male words deep and resonant, the two sounds intertwining, directly crashing into Chen Ji's mind.

"My other half."

Chen Ji's heart abruptly contracted. In his mind, the Tianji Record fragment suddenly burned as hot as if freshly pulled from magma.

text.content:
He instinctively stepped back, the cowardlytrash expression that had adorned his face finally showing cracks.

Twin Fates? Other half? What did all this mean?

Chen Ji forced himself tocalm下来, his mind racing at lightning speed. He had witnessed countless grand scenes, fought wits with Ling Yuan, battled against Han Lie, even handled Holy Sect pursuit with composure.

But now, he was truly bewildered.

dialogue.content:
"No need for surprise." The Twin Fates gracefully descended to the cliff's edge, a mere thirty zhang from Chen Ji. That female face displayed a playful smile, "Why do you think the Tianji Record would choose you? A servant disciple of Tianqing Sect, with mediocre cultivation talent—凭什么 could you command this ancient supreme treasure?"

Chen Ji said nothing, but his back was already soaked with cold sweat.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed again in his mind, yet carried unprecedented panic: "Chen Ji, this is... this is the projection of the Heavenly Dao's Eye! How could it appear here? It shouldn't—according to the original fate trajectory, it was supposed to manifest at least three more years!"

Chen Ji coldly smiled in his heart. Three years later to manifest? So the wings of this butterfly he was had already quietly changed the flow of fate.

Only, the price of this change seemed somewhat too great.

dialogue.content:
"You and I are one." The male voice of the Twin Fates spoke, those deep eyes seemingly containing the operating laws of the entire universe, "The Tianji Record is the Heavenly Dao's chessboard, and you... are the chess player it selected. But both of us know..."

That female face suddenly leaned closer, the vertical eye swirling with threads of fate: "Sometimes, there isn't much difference between chess player and chess piece."

"What do you want?" Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice hoarse and low.

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing his chaotic heartbeat to calm. He stared at that似笑非笑的 female face, while in his mind he swiftly calculated escape strategies.

The Tianji Record fragment in his palm burned slightly, as if warning him of something. He knew this mysterious classic would never react so violently without reason.

At this crossroads of fate, he had to make a choice—but first, he had to survive today.

choice.prompt: Facing this sudden Twin Fates, Chen Ji had to respond. His first reaction would determine the subsequent direction.

choices.description: Since avoidance is impossible, better to take the initiative. First probe what this so-called "other half" actually means, then seek weaknesses.
choices.visible_cost: Revealing one's insight might attract greater threats
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial information, understand the true origin of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The opponent is a transcendent Heavenly Will; any probing might expose your trump cards

text.content:
"One?" Chen Ji coldly laughed, "If you truly were my other half, why have I never sensed your existence? Stop trying to frighten me with tricks. Though I, Chen Ji, am atrash, I cannot be cowed by a few words."

His words were like blades, mercilessly stabbing toward that ethereal face.

dialogue.content:
Upon hearing this, the Twin Fates did not get angry; instead, they smiled even deeper. "Interesting." That female face slightly tilted, "After all these years, finally a human who dares to question me. You have courage—but are you certain you want to do this?"

An无形 pressure suddenly descended, Chen Ji felt his very soul trembling.

choices.description: Continue playing thetrash persona, presenting a weak demeanor. Observe the opponent's reactions, seek the Twin Fates' weaknesses or true intentions.
choices.visible_cost: Might be seen through by the opponent, inviting greater contempt
choices.visible_reward: Preserve trump cards, leaving room for future counterattacks
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao can pierce through fate, its insight far surpasses the mortal realm, and it may see through your disguise.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, and a perfectly measured look of terror appeared on his face. He stepped back two paces, his voice trembling: "P-Predecessor... I am merely a humble servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect. How could I possibly deserve your summons? Is there some misunderstanding..." His eyes flickered uncertainly, portraying the panic and helplessness of atrash disciple to perfection.

dialogue.content: The Twin of Destiny watched his performance silently, and a meaningful smile appeared on that feminine face: "Misunderstanding? The Tianji Record has never been wrong. How could the one it has chosen be atrash?" Those deep eyes seemed capable of seeing through all illusions, piercing directly into the depths of Chen Ji's soul.

choices.text: Quietly observe and wait for developments
choices.description: Make no statement, maintain silence and observe. Since the other party has voluntarily revealed themselves, they must have ulterior motives. Let them show their cards first.
choices.visible_cost: Passively waiting may cause one to miss the initiative
choices.visible_reward: See through the other party's intentions, buy time to think
choices.risk_hint: Silence may be seen as provocation, but could also make the other party lose patience

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak. He simply stood silently in place, his gaze as tranquil as a stagnant pool of water. He understood perfectly. Before figuring out the other party's capabilities, any words might be superfluous. He chose silence—this was one of his most skilled strategies. The wind from the cliff bottom blew past, lifting his thin garments and stirring the black-and-white intertwined long hair of the Twin of Destiny.

dialogue.content: "Deserving of being chosen by the Tianji Record indeed." The Twin of Destiny let out a light laugh, "Knowing to maintain silence is the wisest choice when information is asymmetric. Very well, I appreciate intelligent people." That feminine face slightly lifted, and mysterious light swirled within the vertical eye: "Then, let me show you something more clearly."

text.content: The Twin of Destiny waved a hand, and a purple-golden light shot from that vertical eye, striking directly at the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's hand. The fragment suddenly erupted with dazzling golden light, those originally blurry runes becoming crystal clear, moving across the page like living things. Chen Ji felt his consciousness violently pulled into some unknown space. All around was an endless star sea, and before him floated two volumes of the Tianji Record—one incomplete, one complete. "Do you see it clearly?" that androgynous voice echoed through the star sea, "That is the true Tianji Record, and what you hold... is merely a fragment of one of its pages."

Chen Ji stared intently at that complete Tianji Record, his heart pounding violently. Complete... so the Tianji Record was complete, and what he held was merely a fragment? That complete Tianji Record radiated a gentle glow, as if calling to him. Yet the fragment in his hands trembled slightly, seemingly resonating with the complete version. "Do you understand now?" The Twin of Destiny's voice carried seduction, "You and the Tianji Record are fundamentally two sides of one entity. You are the writer, and I am... the reviewer. Together, we compose the fate of this world."

choice.prompt: The truth of the Tianji Record is being revealed, and Chen Ji must decide how to respond to this shocking blow of information.

choices.description: No matter what the other party says, he will never acknowledge this absurd theory of "one entity." Fate lies in one's own hands, not as a chess piece for any existence.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Eye of Heavenly Dao, inviting direct annihilation
choices.visible_reward: Express one's stance, maintain dominance of self-awareness
choices.risk_hint: Directly confronting the will of Heavenly Dao carries extreme risk, but may earn the other's respect

text.content: "Two sides of one entity?" Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, that laughter echoing through the star sea, carrying a hint of madness, "Ridiculous! I, Chen Ji, have flesh and blood, thoughts and a soul. I have never been anyone's chess piece!" He firmly grasped the fragment in his hand, his eyes flashing with determination: "Even Heavenly Dao shall not control me!"

dialogue.content: The Twin of Destiny fell silent for a moment, and an odd expression appeared on that feminine face—like appreciation, yet also like regret. "You reject me..." that voice softly sounded, "Very well. This makes things more interesting, doesn't it?" Suddenly, a destructive force burst forth from those deep eyes, surging directly toward Chen Ji.

choices.description: Neither deny nor affirm, first accept the existence of this information, then find ways to verify it. Before the true truth, maintaining rationality is most important.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as weak, allowing the other party to press forward step by step
choices.visible_reward: 争取更多信息，延缓冲突爆发
choices.risk_hint: An ambiguous attitude may lead the other party to believe you are easily manipulated

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, the shock in his eyes gradually giving way to contemplation. He spoke slowly: "You say the Tianji Record and I are two sides of the same coin... what proof do you have?"

His tone was no longer questioning, but carried a hint of calm verification. That was him—no matter what situation he faced, he could quickly adjust his mindset and analyze problems from the most rational angle.

dialogue.content:
"Proof?" The Twin Destinies laughed lightly, "Every one of your visions is supported by me behind the scenes. Where do you think those five Heavenly Fate points went?"

Chen Ji's heart shuddered. He had always thought the Heavenly Fate points were consumed by the Tianji Record itself, but so it turned out... they had been feeding this so-called 'Eyes of Heavenly Secrets'?

choices.description: Regardless of the truth, he cared more about why the other party was telling him this. The initiative lay in knowing what the other party wanted.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing one's core demands risks being exploited by the other party
choices.visible_reward: Probing the other party's intentions to seize negotiation initiative
choices.risk_hint: The will of Heavenly Secrets may far exceed your imagination

text.content:
"Even if what you say is true." Chen Ji's voice returned to calm as he stared directly into those abyssal eyes, "Why would you, a dignified Will of Heavenly Secrets, personally appear to tell me this?"

A cold smile curved his lips: "There must be an agenda behind this. Speak—what do you want me to do?"

dialogue.content:
A genuine smile appeared on the Twin Destinies' faces—a satisfaction of prey finally taking the bait.

"Clever." The male face nodded slightly, "Since you're so direct, I'll be straightforward too—I need you to help me do one thing. In return, I'll tell you how to save your sister."

The name Chen Nian caused Chen Ji's pupils to contract sharply.

text.content:
In Chen Ji's mind, Chen Nian's childish face flashed by. That sister taken away by the Holy Sect, used as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' whom he had never stopped searching for all these years.

And now, the Eyes of Heavenly Secrets had taken the initiative to mention her. What did this mean?

"My sister..." Chen Ji's voice tightened slightly, but he quickly suppressed his emotions, "Do you know where she is?"

dialogue.content:
The Twin Destinies nodded slowly, a meaningful smile appearing on the female face: "Chen Nian... Heavenly Fate Lock Key, the most precious sacrifice of the Holy Sect. In three more months, she will be offered to the ancient seal."

Chen Ji's hands unconsciously clenched into fists, his knuckles turning white from the pressure.

"And I can tell you how to save her." The Twin Destinies' voice was full of temptation, "All I need is... for you to retrieve something for me."

text.content:
The Star Sea began to tremble as the complete Tianji Record drifted slowly toward Chen Ji, stopping three feet away.

"That is..." Chen Ji stared intently at the scroll radiating gentle light, his heart pounding like a drum.

"The Source of Heavenly Secrets." The Twin Destinies' voice rang out, "A portion of my power that was split away back then, now sealed within the complete Tianji Record. If I retrieve it, I can truly descend into this world."

Chen Ji finally understood. The so-called 'cooperation' was merely asking him to open the gate to disaster. Once the Source of Heavenly Secrets returned, the Eyes of Heavenly Secrets would possess the ability to directly intervene in the mortal world.

At that time, the entire cultivation world would become its chessboard.

choice.prompt: The Eyes of Heavenly Secrets' deal had been laid on the table—exchange the Source of Heavenly Secrets for Chen Nian's life. Chen Ji had to make the final choice.

choices.description: No matter how important his sister was, he could not use the entire world as the price. His sister, he would save himself!
choices.visible_cost: Thoroughly offending the Eyes of Heavenly Secrets would inevitably lead to frantic retaliation in the future
choices.visible_reward: Maintain original intention, refusing to become a chess piece of Heavenly Secrets
choices.risk_hint: The Eyes of Heavenly Secrets will not easily let go of those who refuse it

text.content:
"You're dreaming." Chen Ji said word by word, his voice ice-cold without a trace of warmth, "Even if what you say is true, even if my sister is truly in mortal danger—I, Chen Ji, will never trade the lives of the world for her sake."

He suddenly raised his hand, holding the broken Tianji Record across his chest: "Because I know, even if I agreed to you today, she would never forgive me."

dialogue.content:
The Twin Destinies fell silent. A complex emotion flickered across that female face—was it anger? Disappointment? Or... a kind of indescribable appreciation?

"Interesting." That voice spoke again, but with an added chill, "You've refused my kindness, Chen Ji. Since that's the case... let us meet on the battlefield."

A terrifying power erupted from those deep eyes, and the surrounding Star Sea began to twist violently.

choices.description: Make no promises, but don't refuse directly either. Let the other party prove they truly have a way to save Chen Nian before discussing further.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as mere probing, leaving room for the other party to manipulate
choices.visible_reward: Buy crucial information for rescuing his sister
choices.risk_hint: Delaying tactics may provoke the Eyes of Heavenly Secrets

text.content:
"I'll handle my sister's matter myself." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "But I need to verify the method you mentioned first. Tell me the specific steps to save her. If it's truly feasible... we can discuss further."

He understood perfectly—before true strength, any sweet words were hollow. What he needed was time, information, the possibility to reverse fate.

dialogue.content:
The Fate Twins exchanged a glance, and a playful smile appeared on the male's face.

"Trying to buy time?" He seemed to see through Chen Ji's thoughts. "It doesn't matter. Our meeting was destined anyway. Here's a hint—go to the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, seek the 'Altar of Heavenly Fate.' There you'll find the answers you seek."

With that, the figure slowly began to fade.

choices.description: "Pretend to accept the opponent's conditions while secretly seeking a way to break the situation. He would save his sister's life, but the Heavenly Dao Origin must never fall into the enemy's hands."
choices.visible_cost: "Must continuously perform before the Heavenly Eye of Fate, immense pressure"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain crucial intelligence while laying the groundwork for a later counterattack"
choices.risk_hint: "The Heavenly Eye of Fate can see through destiny; its insight far surpasses the mortal realm"

text.content:
Chen Ji remained silent for a long while before slowly nodding.

"Alright. I accept."

His voice was soft, so soft that even he could barely hear it. But in those eyes burned an unyielding fire.

—He thinks he can deceive me? Then let him deceive. In the end, who's the prey remains to be seen.

dialogue.content:
The Fate Twins' faces bloomed with radiant smiles; the female's countenance was breathtakingly beautiful.

"Excellent." That voice was like heavenly music. "Then, our game... officially begins."

The star sea suddenly collapsed, and Chen Ji's consciousness was violently thrown back to reality.

text.content:
When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he found himself still standing by the cliff's edge.

The Tianji Record in his hand had regained its calm, but the newly added rune on that page was faintly glowing, as if recording everything that had just transpired.

Heavenly Eye of Fate... Fate Twins... One entity, two aspects...

Each piece of information poured into his mind like molten iron, every single one enough to overturn his understanding of this world. But Chen Ji simply stood there quietly, his gaze deep as an abyss.

"Excellent." He murmured softly, the corner of his mouth slightly lifting. "Games... I love them the most."

He turned to gaze toward the Tianqing Sect below the mountain. His silhouette stretched long in the setting sun. From this moment on, another unprecedented opponent had been added to his chessboard.

Just as Chen Ji was about to leave, the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand suddenly began to vibrate violently. Those newly added runes started burning on their own, emitting scorching light.

A piece of information he had never seen before emerged from the fragment, shooting directly into the depths of his consciousness—that was the mysterious power released by the Heavenly Eye of Fate that resonated with Chen Ji's bloodline.

Chen Ji groaned, dropping to one knee. At his Brow Center, a purple-gold mark was slowly forming, echoing the vertical eye on the Fate Twins' foreheads.

"What is this..." His voice turned hoarse. "What has it left on me?"
